title: MILE-RefHumEval: A Reference-Free, Multi-Independent LLM Framework for Human-Aligned Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical evaluation framework for LLMs across general NLP tasks (summarization, dialogue, image captioning). While it includes 'Bias and Fairness' as one of twelve evaluation criteria in its schema, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific ethical systems.
